title: Binary curcuminoid complex CRE-Bin inhibits osteoclast differentiation by suppressing the canonical NF-kappaB signaling pathway and modulating microRNA-223 expression.
authors: Jantarawong, Sompot; Khimmaktong, Wipapan; Swangphon, Piyawut; Lauterbach, Natda; Nanakorn, Natthaphon; Panichayupakaranant, Pharkphoom; Pengjam, Yutthana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素复合物抑制破骨细胞分化，涉及miRNA与NF-kB复合物的分子对接，但核心是细胞信号通路而非TF-DNA互作，方法仅简单对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Curcuminoids, the major bioactive compounds in Curcuma longa L., inhibit osteoclast differentiation-a key process in bone resorption. microRNA-223 regulates osteoclast differentiation by targeting nuclear factor I-A. How curcuminoids influence osteoclast differentiation through microRNA-223 is unclear. This study investigated the effects of CRE-Bin-a binary curcuminoid complex of a curcuminoid-rich extract and hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin-on osteoclast differentiation. In murine receptor activator of nuclear factor-kappaB ligand-stimulated RAW 264.7 macrophages, CRE-Bin inhibited osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption by reducing tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase activity, cathepsin K expression, reactive oxygen species production, and canonical NF-kappaB signaling pathway. CRE-Bin suppressed microRNA-223 expression at the primary, precursor, and mature stages while upregulating nuclear factor I-A expression, suggesting dual regulatory effects. Molecular docking simulations demonstrated strong interactions between microRNA-223 and the IkappaBalpha/p50/p65 complex, indicating crosstalk between microRNA-223 and canonical NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Binding affinity predictions revealed moderate interactions between curcuminoids and mature microRNA-223, underscoring their potential for microRNA-targeted modulation. These findings position CRE-Bin as a promising multitarget therapeutic agent for bone-related disorders and diseases, warranting experimental and computational investigations.
abstract_zh: 姜黄素类化合物是姜黄（Curcuma longa L.）中的主要生物活性成分，可抑制破骨细胞分化——这是骨吸收的关键过程。microRNA-223通过靶向核因子I-A调控破骨细胞分化。姜黄素类化合物如何通过microRNA-223影响破骨细胞分化尚不清楚。本研究探讨了CRE-Bin——一种富含姜黄素类化合物的提取物与羟丙基-β-环糊精的二元姜黄素类复合物——对破骨细胞分化的影响。在小鼠核因子κB受体活化因子配体刺激的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞中，CRE-Bin通过降低抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶活性、组织蛋白酶K表达、活性氧产生及经典NF-κB信号通路，抑制了破骨细胞分化和骨吸收。CRE-Bin在初级、前体和成熟阶段抑制microRNA-223表达，同时上调核因子I-A表达，表明其具有双重调控作用。分子对接模拟显示microRNA-223与IkappaBalpha/p50/p65复合物之间存在强相互作用，提示microRNA-223与经典NF-κB信号通路之间存在串扰。结合亲和力预测显示姜黄素类化合物与成熟microRNA-223之间存在中等相互作用，凸显了其靶向调控microRNA的潜力。这些发现将CRE-Bin定位为骨相关疾病和病症的有前景的多靶点治疗剂，值得进一步的实验和计算研究。
